output.brief: The evidence points to the smart-TV app 5.2 release, not the new CDN. App 5.2 went live on 9 October, the same day as the CDN cutover, so the two were confounded. Session data for 12–25 October settles it. Smart-TV 5.2 sessions stall 5.9% of the time. Every other client, including 5.1 TVs, web and mobile, stalls about 0.6–0.7% while also served by Tessaline. The 5.2 problem appears equally on all three ISPs, so ISP congestion isn't the cause. The handball launch began on 11 October, after the rise started, and match nights show no extra stalling. Do not send the breach notice, withhold fees or switch back to Corvane. Switching back wouldn't fix the problem and would penalise the wrong party. Do not mute the alert. Instead, revert 5.2's adaptive-streaming behaviour to the 5.1 settings in Kestria and hold the wider 5.2 rollout until the regression is fixed. 5.2 also starts video faster (1.5 s versus 2.4 s), so look at its start-up and buffering tuning. Add app version and device breakdowns to the dashboard and alerts, though that waits for the Q1 2027 pipeline rebuild. Hold off on the free-month offer. The 1 October price rise also plausibly drove the October cancellations, and no evidence I collected links the cancellations to buffering. Confidence is high on the cause. It is moderate on cancellations.
